storeInfo.name: Azteca Market
storeInfo.tagline: Auténtica comida mexicana y abacería tradicional en Bridgeport

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del mercado.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the market.
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en la calle y lote trasero.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking and rear lot available.

products.descriptionEs: Aguacate Hass fresco machacado al momento con tomate, cebolla, cilantro, chile jalapeño y jugo de limón fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly smashed Hass avocado with ripe tomatoes, onions, cilantro, jalapeño, and fresh lime juice.

products.descriptionEs: Mezcla de quesos mexicanos fundidos al horno con auténtico chorizo casero, servido con tortillas de maíz calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Melted Mexican cheeses baked with authentic homemade chorizo, served with warm corn tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Tres masa gruesa de maíz ligeramente frita, cubierta con frijoles refritos, lechuga, crema, queso fresco y tu elección de carne.
products.descriptionEn: Three thick, lightly fried corn masa bases topped with refried beans, lettuce, crema, fresh cheese, and your choice of meat.
Marinated al pastor pork tacos with roasted pineapple, cilantro, and finely diced onions on handmade corn tortillas.
Giant flour tortilla stuffed with tender grilled steak, Mexican rice, black beans, melted cheese, and sour cream.
Three shredded chicken enchiladas smothered in homemade red sauce, topped with fresh cheese and Mexican crema.
Thin cuts of marinated grilled steak served with a cheese enchilada, guacamole, pot beans, and grilled spring onions.
Tender chicken piece smothered in our complex and aromatic mole sauce made from dried chilis, spices, and chocolate.
Crispy bolillo roll stuffed with tender pork carnitas, drowned in spicy chile de árbol sauce and pickled red onions.
Traditional handcrafted Mexican beverage made with rice, milk, vanilla, and a touch of cinnamon.
Refreshing infusion of natural hibiscus flowers, lightly sweetened and served ice-cold.
Authentic Mexican soda sweetened with pure cane sugar. Flavors: Mandarin, Grapefruit, Tamarind, or Pineapple.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con tacos vegetarianos, guacamole fresco y varias opciones preparadas con tortillas de maíz 100% naturales.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian tacos, fresh guacamole, and several options made with 100% natural corn tortillas.

faqs.qEs: ¿Tienen servicio de abacería y mercado además del restaurante?
faqs.qEn: Do you have a grocery market section in addition to the restaurant?
faqs.aEs: ¡Así es! Contamos con una sección de productos hispanos, especias, quesos y artículos tradicionales mexicanos.
faqs.aEn: That's right! We feature a grocery section with Hispanic products, spices, cheeses, and traditional Mexican goods.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept phone orders for pickup?
faqs.aEs: Sí, puede llamar directamente a nuestro local para preparar su pedido con anticipación.
faqs.aEn: Yes, you can call our store directly to have your order prepared in advance.
